title: useNumberInput Hook
description:
Implement a `useNumberInput` hook that returns `{ value, increment, decrement, set }`. `increment` adds `step` to the value, clamped at `max`. `decrement` subtracts `step`, clamped at `min`. `set(n)` sets any value within bounds.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, increment, decrement, set } = useNumberInput({ initial: 5, step: 2, min: 0, max: 10 });
```
ai_context: Common mistake: applying clamp only on increment/decrement but not on set — all value-changing operations should clamp to keep the value within the declared bounds.
